description: Padatious × Nebulento fusion — the neural parser leads at high confidence, fuzzy string matching mops up typos and ASR noise, neural medium catches the rest.
notes: HYPOTHESIS: does a neural template classifier (Padatious) at high confidence, backed by a fuzzy template matcher (Nebulento) tuned for typos/ASR noise, beat either alone — and does retrying Padatious at a looser gate afterward recover cases the fuzzy stage still missed? Padatious's internal padaos exact-match gate already covers regex-perfect input (verified in ovos_padatious/intent_container.py), so this pair specifically probes the neural-vs-fuzzy paraphrase gap, not exact-match duplication.
